outputs.role: Detailed hand albedo on the original UV layout
outputs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: UV albedo texture for a 3D human hand. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET; image 2 is only the human hand skin reference. Make one targeted correction to image 1: make the wrinkles look like actual soft supple human skin, not orange etched lines or carved wood. Reduce and narrow the dark orange crease color by about 45 percent, especially on the finger joints, while preserving their anatomical locations, all crisp pores, and natural fine folds. The smallest folds must be delicate and uneven, not an all-over maze. Keep mature tan skin, natural red/pink knuckles and slightly cool translucent veins, warm beige healthy nail plates, softly pink nail beds and cuticles. Keep pale skin areas from looking chalk white. The resulting albedo should have subtle microcontrast, with the 3D geometry and normal material supplying light and shadow. Preserve the exact UV island positions, outlines, size, orientation, finger and nail locations, black cap and terracotta background, and the exact dorsal mole location. Absolutely no reshaping, cropping, rotating or repositioning any island. No painted hairs, directional shadows or specular highlights. No added text. Output the same square atlas arrangement, with sharp photographic detail at the largest feasible resolution.

outputs.role: Forearm albedo at a physical 8 cm scale, blended over the wrist
outputs.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless PBR diffuse albedo texture, flat square skin surface for the forearm of a 3D human. Generate only a continuous close-up tile of warm tan mature adult male FOREARM skin. Image 1 defines the skin color and age that this texture must match. Image 2 is the quality reference for the human arm on the left. Match its fine natural intersecting epidermal lines, tiny pores, subtle irregular warm/cool tone mottling, very faint veins and scattered small freckles. This image represents an 8x8 cm patch of forearm skin. It must have rich sharp photographic surface detail, with small irregular polygonal plateaus and fine branching wrinkles, not grain or geometric repeated patterns. No hand shape, wrist silhouette, fingers or nails: entire square filled with skin. No visible hairs painted into the image, since separate hair geometry will be added in 3D. No specular highlights, no directional shadows, no deep black creases: flat cross-polarized diffuse lighting suitable for an albedo map. Make all four edges continuous and seamless for texture repetition. Match image 1’s warmer tan tone without orange saturation. No background, objects, text or watermark. Largest feasible square resolution.

limits: The generated textures are 1254 square pixels; they are not a 4K scan.
The GLB contains the rigged mesh and base albedo. Epidermal relief, forearm blending, hair and volume-preserving motion are completed by the runtime.
